text:
mari: Pushed the continuous-batcher heuristic tweak at 02:10 UTC (lowered token_budget target, more aggressive prefill). Seeing a ~9% throughput drop and a small-tail latency bump for short requests on 4xA100 pools.
ashok: ugh. did the canary run finish? any obvious metric flips in the canary?
mari: Canary looked fine during the 45min window, but production shows sustained queue growth on small reqs. Attached quick flame.
devon: can you paste the flame or perf output? my suspicion: batch shape changed and we triggered a kernel fallback to the slower matmul path.
mari: flame snippet:```
--- kernel_hotspots ---
kernel: fused_attention_fast_path  42%
kernel: nv_matmul_generic         31%
kernel: kv_prefetch               12%
kernel: memcopy                   9%
```
devon: that 31% nv_matmul_generic is the red flag. continuous-batcher changed join behavior so more odd-shaped microbatches are formed. kernel selector sees low-density shape and picks generic path.
tara: also seeing KV cache churn in the same timeframe — eviction rate up ~3.2x. small requests are not reusing prefix cache as much after the prefill tweak.
mari: yes observed more KV misses in telemetry. Misses correlate with the small-request tail.
ashok: timeline: heuristic change -> more prefill attempts -> more short-window joins -> kernel fallback + KV misses -> latency/throughput regressions. makes sense.
devon: quick mitigation options: revert heuristic, or tighten the pack-by-latency threshold so short requests don't get forced into odd-shaped merges. also tune token_budget downward for small-route class.
tara: can we flip a per-route override for the affected customer pool? that would give immediate relief while we iterate.
ci-bot: deploy v2.14.3 to canary at 02:09:50 UTC by mari (completed)
mari: rolling a routing tweak to reduce pack-by-latency window from 120ms -> 60ms on the 4xA100 pool for a canary now. will watch.
ashok: also capture kernel selection trace for one hour after tweak. need to confirm kernel percentages return to baseline.
devon: if we can't fix quickly, plan to revert to previous heuristic version. we need an RFC for a safer default: prefer kernel-affinity preservation over marginal batching gain.
mari: updated canary at 02:25 UTC. early signals: queue length down, nv_matmul_generic dropped to 8% in the quick sample. KV miss rate back to baseline.
tara: good. keep an eye for side effects on throughput.
ashok: follow-up tasks: 1) run tighter profiling across shapes and token_budget values (devon), 2) add per-route token_budget defaults and route override UI flag (mari), 3) bake a kernel-affinity heuristic precedence in selector (devon), 4) create retrospective postmortem if we revert (tara).
mari: filing follow-ups now. thanks all. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: alert: automated anomaly detector registered latency delta at 02:12 UTC for pool-4xA100 (investigation thread opened).
